title: P0 mRNA Design Validation
description: Validation benchmark: analyse a known mRNA sequence for CAI (codon optimisation) and MFE (secondary structure) quality metrics.

genbank_id.description: GenBank accession ID of the reference sequence (default: SARS-CoV-2 Wuhan-Hu-1).

orf_start.description: 1-based inclusive start position of the ORF within the GenBank record.

orf_end.description: 1-based inclusive end position of the ORF.

cai_threshold.description: Codon Adaptation Index threshold. CAI > 0.9 indicates highly optimised codon usage.

mfe_threshold.description: Minimum free energy threshold (kcal/mol). MFE < −150 indicates significant secondary structure.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
